observations: Three photos show two identical car headlight assemblies lying side by side on a tiled floor.
The headlights have a modern design with clear lenses, black housings, and integrated turn signals (orange sections).
The left side of each headlight has a visible amber turn signal and a circular projector lens.
The right side has a rectangular LED daytime running light strip.
The housing appears to be made of black plastic with mounting points and electrical connectors visible.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the headlights in any photo.
The watermark 'LINUS AUTO - LIGHT SOLUTION' is present on all photos.
The seller's text claims 'All models of cars accessories available' and 'Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.'

claims.claim: All models of cars accessories available
claims.evidence: The photos show only one specific headlight assembly; no other accessories are visible. The claim cannot be verified from the images alone.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The headlights may not be compatible with the buyer's vehicle model.
risks.proof: A clear photo showing the model number or VIN tag on the back of the headlight assembly, or a photo of the headlight installed on a specific car.
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic or non-genuine, which may reduce value significantly.

risks.risk: The headlights may be damaged or non-functional (e.g., cracked lens, broken connectors, or internal bulb failure).
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens for cracks, and a photo of the backside showing the electrical connectors and mounting points.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-functional or damaged, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The headlights may be counterfeit or reconditioned parts.
risks.proof: A photo of the part number or barcode on the back of the headlight, or a photo of the part installed on a vehicle with visible VIN or model plate.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified authenticity, which may reduce value.

proof_requests: Close-up of the VIN plate, usually on the dashboard or engine bay.
Photo of the back of the headlight showing any part numbers or model identifiers.
Photo of the headlight installed on a specific car or with a visible VIN plate.
Close-up of the lens for cracks or damage.
Photo of the electrical connectors and mounting points.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
